svg.title: Peter McVries — OSINT researcher and edge developer
svg.desc: Static banner. Peter McVries, OSINT researcher and edge developer for the Vulnerable Defense League of New York. Thesis: what Wall Street hoards, we hand back. Free, self-hosted tools for people who cannot buy them, with the method published alongside. Contrast computed from hex against the panel: primary text 15.60 to 1, accent 9.36 to 1, secondary label 8.10 to 1. No animation.
